title: Nvidia Confirmed Chip Tracking Is Possible
excerpt: Nvidia privately stated that tracking chips to stop smuggling is technically feasible, despite public industry doubts.
body_html:
Nvidia representatives privately confirmed that implementing anti-smuggling measures is technically possible. This statement was shared with Illinois Representative Bill Foster, according to an interview on Thursday.

The discussion relates to proposed requirements in the Chip Security Act. The confirmation from Nvidia contrasts with claims made by an industry group, which previously described such anti-smuggling measures as potentially infeasible. Representative Foster, a Democrat, serves on the committee handling related legislative matters.
